## History

Harmon Andrews is a minor figure mentioned in the context of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community. He is noted as a resident of the area where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends engage in their imaginative play, such as their dramatic reenactment on the local pond.

## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harmon-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Harmon Andrews is a relative of [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) who came to her rescue during an incident on the water. When [Jane](../character/jane.md) nearly fell overboard into the lake, Harmon caught her by her sash to prevent her from falling in. Their connection is defined by this moment of quick intervention during a group outing.

- Saved — caught her by her sash as she nearly fell overboard into the lake  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>
